messages:
sylvia: Quick ping — PR #4412 is ready for merge once docs + release notes are signed off. It contains: changelog entry for model-zet deprecation, migration guide updates, python/js SDK snippets, and a small note about kv-cache behavior.
mike: I'll do a review. pinging @priya @laura for examples and wording. ETA ~1.5h
priya: I can check snippets. Is there a param rename?
sylvia: yep: response_mode -> output_mode. also a minor ctx eviction behavior note for long-running chats.
laura: wording nit: prefer "scheduled removal" with date instead of "deprecated and removed soon". also add link to migrations anchor.
sylvia: updated wording and pushed.
ci-bot: Preview build for PR #4412 — status: failed. Reason: missing anchor migrations#model-zet and one broken internal link. Logs: /artifacts/4412/log.txt
ben: will add anchor + fix link. also saw python snippet indentation issue; pushing a tiny patch.
ben: patch pushed: added anchor, fixed link, adjusted python snippet formatting. cc @priya
priya: reviewing updated snippets. added short note about default kv-cache eviction change. all good otherwise.
mike: re-running preview.
ci-bot: Preview built for PR #4412 — status: success. Diff summary: +1 migration anchor, +2 lines migration guide, +3 snippet clarifications, -1 ambiguous sentence in changelog.
laura: content approved. one request: include a parenthetical recommending quantization profile q4_0 for users switching to the lightweight replacement.
sylvia: added that suggestion and referenced SDK version containing the rename.
mike: engineering approves — compatibility and fallback behavior validated in staging. approved.
sylvia: propose merge after maintenance window on 2026-04-12 03:00 UTC. planning merge at 03:15 UTC with a 20-min canary. objections?
ben: no objections. scheduling canary and monitors.
priya: fine.
laura: fine.
eng-bot: Scheduled merge for PR #4412 at 2026-04-12T03:15:00Z by request of @sylvia. Canary window: 2026-04-12T03:15:00Z — 2026-04-12T03:35:00Z.
sylvia: thanks :thumbsup:
